rules: 15min bars; reaction = closure: extreme bar's low (high) below the 2 prior bars AND the lowest low (highest high) of the prior 20 bars (the swept low); opposing series = contiguous down-close (up-close) candles ending at the extreme (or <=2 bars before), <=10 long; first close beyond that series' first-candle OPEN within 10 candles, no new extreme first
T0 = the closing candle's close; R = |close - extreme|; expansion level E = close + 1R in the reaction direction
stale: M1 bars starting in [T0, T0+20min) (>= 18 of them) touched neither E nor the swept extreme; decision_time = T0 + 20 min
hit: from the first M1 bar at/after T0+20min, E touched before the extreme within 1380 M1 bars (same bar = 0.5; neither = dropped)

null: same signed distances to E and to the extreme from the first M1 open, same direction, at 5 random moments within +/-30 days and +/-30 min NY clock; claim '-' (stale setups expand less often than the geometry implies)
scope: T0 inside the forex NY AM window 07:00-10:00 New York
